description:
Search environmental documents

Searches environmental documents (Omgevingswet and Wro) in context for the
given location. Returns all applicable plans, environmental plans and related
documents. Accepts coordinates or a postcode.

Source: [DSO Omgevingsinformatie Ontsluiten v2](https://developer.omgevingswet.overheid.nl/api-register/api/omgevingsinformatie-ontsluiten/)

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: dso.documents
